Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep it between us. I won't pass the Bluefin or Albany details to Ruth or anyone else, and I won't post them in a channel.

If Ruth needs to know before it's public, she's the right person to brief, and that call is yours to make. If you want help getting it to her, tell me how you'd like to handle it and I'll help you put it together.
